name: F-687d drain preview
description: The stderr note printed when input pasted or typed after a terminal prompt is discarded (F-687c/F-687d). Normative for mnemonic-toolkit and mnemonic-secret; identical copies live in crates/mnemonic-toolkit/tests/vectors/ and crates/ms-cli/vectors/. `input` is the discarded input exactly as read; `note` is the exact stderr text.
rule: One header line, then one line per discarded line, indented two spaces.
A line of only whitespace (or empty) is '(blank)'.

A line of at most 8 characters (Unicode scalar values, not bytes) is shown as is; a longer one as its first 8 characters, '…', and '(W word(s), N chars)' where W counts whitespace-separated words and N characters of the whole line.

In what is shown, each control character, each escape sequence (CSI ESC [ ... final byte @..~; OSC ESC ] ... BEL or ESC \; any other ESC x) and each of U+200B-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+FEFF is replaced by one '?'.

cases.why: a pasted 12-word seed shows its first 8 characters and the counts; a short line is shown in full
cases.input:
abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about
ls -la
cases.note:
note: discarded 2 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used):
  abandon … (12 words, 93 chars)
  ls -la

note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used):
  12345678

cases.why: 9 characters: first 8, then the counts (singular word)
cases.note:
note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used):
  12345678… (1 word, 9 chars)

note: discarded 2 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used):
  (blank)
  (blank)
